context: A medium-sized company needs a leave workflow covering balances, approvals, conflicts, evidence, escalation, calendars, payroll integration, auditability, and response time.

requirements.text: Employees must be able to submit leave requests with leave type, dates, and reason.
The system must show the employee's available leave balance before submission.
requirements.reveal_condition: Ask how employees know remaining leave.

requirements.text: A direct manager must approve or reject each leave request.
requirements.reveal_condition: Ask who decides a leave request.

requirements.text: The system must reject leave dates that overlap an approved request for the same employee.
requirements.condition: when same employee already has approved leave

requirements.text: Sick leave longer than three consecutive days requires a medical document.
requirements.reveal_condition: Ask when sick leave needs documentation.
requirements.condition: sick leave longer than three consecutive days

requirements.text: Requests unanswered for two working days should be escalated to the next-level manager.
requirements.reveal_condition: Ask what happens when a manager does not respond.

requirements.text: Approved leave should appear on the shared team calendar without displaying the private reason.
requirements.reveal_condition: Ask how approved leave is shared while preserving privacy.

requirements.text: Approved unpaid leave must be sent to payroll before the monthly payroll cutoff.
Every approval, rejection, cancellation, and balance adjustment must be auditable.
requirements.reveal_condition: Ask how leave decisions are audited.

requirements.text: The leave dashboard should load within two seconds for 95 percent of requests under normal load.
requirements.condition: within two seconds for 95 percent of requests
